title: Fishysalmon02 Salmon
body:
turns salmon into the player "Fishysalmon02"

This makes the salmon have the eyes & mouth of the player "Fishysalmon02", as well as swapping out the color pallet of the salmon, to match the aesthetic of salmon that "Fishysalmon02" is (making his salmon the "canon" salmon).

This also changes the salmon bucket, spawn egg, and items, as well as all mentions of "salmon" in the english lang file!
